claim: The score is the sum of twelve criteria; maxima sum to 999 and the minimum is 100 because the payment criterion floors at 100.
There is no separate 100-point base.
Points were derived by logistic regression on historical default data.
The bureau reports a Gini of 0.6 for the new score; sample, period and segment are not published.
The bureau reports a Fraunhofer IAIS review of scientific quality and data relevance; the review report is not public.
Section 37a(2) No. 1(d) BDSG bars use of address data for covered scores from 20 Nov 2026, without exception per the committee note.
Whether the address-age criterion is address data under section 37a is unresolved and the bureau has not publicly explained its treatment.
Section 37a binds both creation and use of a score, so the lender's use is directly conditioned.
BGH 21 Oct 2026: Art 15(1)(h) applies only where Art 22(1) is met; transmission plus timely adverse decision raises a presumption.
Time-dependent criteria carry 280 of 999 points (28%).
Under the step-hold reading, a person with a one-year credit file and perfect behaviour cannot reach the top class.
A 60-month instalment loan lowers the replica score by roughly 70 to 90 points depending on prior state.
MaRisk 06/2026 removes DORA ICT services from AT 9.
Annex III high-risk obligations apply from 2 Dec 2027; legacy systems are caught on significant design change.
Commission guidelines place logistic regression used to improve optimisation outside the AI system definition; scope for decisions on people is disputed.
BaFin is AI market surveillance authority for creditworthiness systems from 29 Jul 2026.
A lender adopting a new score version needs retrospective scoring of its own historical applicants to test discrimination.
Bondora's terms appear to restrict publication of raw rows; only code and aggregates are published.
Old sector scores were adjusted for section 37a and expire on 31 Dec 2028.

On Bondora's out-of-time sample an eight-grade rating had a Gini of 0.37 (95% CI 0.36 to 0.38); as an absolute level this is not comparable across populations, so Mainkai's tolerance is a paired comparison against the current score.
Across Bondora segments, observed defaults ranged from 0.72 to 2.34 times those implied by the grade mix.
Bondora's overall 12-month default rate was 8.3% in 2025 against 8.6% in the reference period while seven of eight grades defaulted more.
Unpublished intermediate bands exist for three time-based criteria; debt-collection inquiry effect has no published value.
MaRisk 06/2026 AT 4.3.4 applies to third-party models used in credit granting and requires a suitability assessment before use, data quality, override rules, regular validation and explainability.
MaRisk 06/2026 BTO 1.2 Tz. 5 bars relying exclusively on external credit assessments.
Criteria 4, 5, 8 and 9 (author check) and the four score-class boundaries (bureau overview page) were confirmed on the bureau's own pages.

The bureau publishes its stored data categories and deletion periods (inquiries 12 months; settled claims and delinquency-free loans 3 years) but not lineage, coverage by criterion or quality measures.
Under s.505a BGB from 20 Nov 2026 a consumer loan may be concluded only if a thorough creditworthiness assessment shows repayment is likely.

From 20 Nov 2026 a rejection resting on automated processing must state the right to review by a person and the contest procedure (s.30(7) sentence 2 BDSG), and failing to inform is an administrative offence (s.43(1) No. 2).

From 20 Nov 2026, s.30(7) BDSG requires a lender that rejects a consumer loan because of credit-agency information to tell the consumer at once of that information, the database used and the data categories considered.
